notes.title: Stardrift Nomads Patch 1.3.0
notes.content:
Here is the Patch Notes for 1.3.0.  This patch is now LIVE

This patch is mainly adjusting the difficulty of the game base off of player feed back as well as a few tweaks to the back end parts of the game.

Gameplay

-Towers have been reduced in price across the board. 
-Towers are also cheeper to upgrade/repair too! Get building those towers now!
-Equipment upgrades have been reduced.  Players can now upgrade their gear much quicker.
-[Mechanic] Mega Tower Skill has had its cooldown reduce greatly.
-[Scavanger] Mega Laser Skill deals slightly less damage but has a greater turn speed.

Campaign 

-The first half of the campaign will now have slightly less enemies.
-The difficulty curve for the game should be more gradual as you progress within the campaign. 

Misc

-General minor bug fixes
-Tweaks to the networking systems

See you all next time!  And Happy Holidays!

notes.title: Stardrift Nomads Patch 1.2 and PAX AUS
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Today we updated the game with some new features and our designer Ryan is on his way to PAX AUS to run a booth. He will be handing out some PAX exclusive skin codes for all 3 ships, so make sure to stop by the booth and pick up a code!

Version 1.2 Patch Notes

Added Mutators!
There is a new menu for survival and stockpile game modes with options to change the game and how much XP you get along with it.

New Asteroids!
Watch out for metalic asteroids! 

New Random Events!
We added  3 new random events that can happen while you play. Watch out for abandoned colonys drifting by that you can search for survivors or scrap!

notes.title: Stardrift Nomads Patch 1.1.0 Content Update!
notes.content:
Here is the patch notes for 1.1.0 This patch is now LIVE!

This patch introduces a ton of new content for the game! 

New Mode: Stockpile!

-Players will defend against an endless assault of pirates and asteroids while the colony builds pylons. Players will need to build up enough energy to escape the pirates before they are overrun!
-Stockpile mode will adjust difficulty depending on the party size!
-Pirates will build their own towers on any destroyed pylon they find to keep the player out!
-The amount of pylons the colony produces depends on the amount of players!
-Wave timers are no more in this mode! Pirates and asteroids will come at you non stop so gather that energy fast before they overwhelm you! 

New Enemies: Mini Bosses

- Every type of ship will now have a chance to spawn a mini boss version of itself. 
- Mini bosses will be equip with different abilities from a barrage of homing missile, reflective shields or, teleporting!
- Mini bosses will have unique looking ships that are much bigger then the average ship!

New Boss: The Behemoth 

- The Behemoth is a massive ship that will slowly fly towards the colony and will slam into it if not destroyed in time!
- The Behemoth comes in 5 stages! After he loses a certain percent of his health, he'll drop some of his armor to gain a new ability and more speed!

Gameplay

- Mechanic's Reach skill will no longer leave targets permanently stun
- Time Warp cooldown slightly increased
- EXP rewards for certain enemy kills have been rebalanced

Campaign:

- Text messages will now pop up at the end of the wave so players aren't fighting and reading at the same time [Community Request]
- Starting levels will now have slightly less enemies spawning in.

Graphics:

- A new skin crate has been added into the mix!
- New crate will contain 13 new skins!

Misc:

- Clamp will no longer throw enemies on the Z axis if the player is turning.
- Fix some loading issues for Linux players (Black Screen Bug)
- Enemies exploding sound has been ramp up to hearing levels!
- Projectiles are now calculated on the client side for Multiplayer [Community Request]
- UI added to show the tower button [Community Request]


See you all next time!

notes.title: Update incoming!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We are currently working on an update which will be released very soon, so we wanted to take a minute and share some of the things that we've been working on since release.

The update will focus on adding variability to our wave system and adding new modes of play.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28052433/619a7d2fff9aa000f6522d2059373943a430bb4b.jpg

Each pirate type will now include a miniboss tier for increased destructive power.  Each miniboss is essentially a more deadly version of the base class with increased health, more damaging weapons, improved AI, and even special abilities that will allow them to wreak havoc upon your base.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28052433/e2c09bf8ae1b56ad133f7a024f4be38db0b4eb40.gif
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28052433/b91328c4aa7284534733c7b397d79742c6f9e055.gif

We are also adding a new game mode which focuses on capturing points outside the base and building holding them to produce energy for the colony.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28052433/6c3174e12701837d6bef32c3aae4c4be1449af24.jpg

Every pylon you hold increases your energy production and hastens your victory over the pirates, but they will be fighting hard to take the pylons from you so be ready!

For anyone who is collecting skins or selling them on the marketplace we will be releasing a new crate with thirteen new paintjobs for you to find!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28052433/88e8196b724acd54637c993e38b1173b6fb3a881.jpg

And finally we are pleased to introduce you to the Behemoth, the newest addition to our cast of deadly bosses.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28052433/b34a6e4746d331cb5222b6827938b396e3227b03.png

Better build those walls thick, because this thing will be hard to stop!
 
Let us know what you think and make sure you join the giveaway, good luck everyone!
Thanks for reading.

notes.title: Stardrift Nomads Patch 1.0.4
notes.content:
Here is the patch notes for 1.0.4 This patch is now LIVE!

This patch we focus on fixing up a few things as well as helping new players learn the game a bit more easier. We are also setting the ground work for the new content update coming soon! More info on this as we get closer.

Campaign:

-Pirate Bosses now have intro portraits
-Difficulty reduced slightly on the first few levels of campaign.

Gameplay:

-Lightspeed Duration has been reduce
-Lightspeed Cooldown has been increased
-Lightning Tower now charges faster and deals more damage at max charge
-Caltraps speed reduction has been slightly reduced.
-Pirate Raider has had a damage reduction
-Pirate Raider now grants more then 1 EXP per kill 
-Movement Seal now confuses enemies 1 second longer per upgrade.

Graphics:

-Pirate Carrier now has a new model
-Unlocking a new skin menu has new art
-Fix a few explosions


Misc:

-Play button now defaults to the campaign screen [Community Request]
-Groundwork for new content!
-Few fixes to some bullet collisions.

See you all next time!

notes.title: Beta Patch Notes 0.4.3
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Here is the patch notes for 0.4.3 This patch is now LIVE!

Been a busy week. New patches have been flying out the door in preparation for launch.

Here is a list of all the things that have changed! 

Campaign:

-Bosses now all have voice intro for when they appear. 
-Scrap Asteroid will now stop when the game is paused in single player [Community Bug]

Gameplay:

-Patient (Passive) Now activates after 1 second when you stop moving rather then 5 seconds.
-Mothership (Boss) Now has a new weapon and stronger shields. Careful flying in front of it now :)
-Rocketeers now shoot actual rockets!
-Updated the balance of multiplayer. Now players can expect more enemies then before when playing with others. The more players you have, the bigger the change.
-Bigger asteroids will now spawn a bit sooner then before in survival.
-Clamp should now work properly when using it as a client in multiplayer.


Graphics:

-Brighten the highlighted selection box on skills/gear
-Heat seeking missiles have new art
-New slash animation for the Mechanic when using the Slash ability
-Player ships will start to show signs of damage when enough damage is taken.
-New particle effect for the disabler's ship
-Updated some muzzle flashes and particles for towers
-New texture for the rammer and disabler
-Ion Cannon's projectile has had an model update
-Fix the color of scrap on the mini map (Only when using the radar cargo bay)
-Boss explosions are a bit more worthy now.
-Visual effects changed for the scavengers traps.
-Scrap asteroid now has a new look. Also will rotate as it floats through space. 
-Updated visual on a few different skills. 
-Camera will no longer snap when moving between menu in the main menu [Community Bug]

Misc:

-Scroll Bar on the main menu now works properly with the mouse wheel
-All Achievements have been added to the game
-Fix some bugs when players leave a players lobby.
-More player info on the stats page
-Enemy reference guide is now in! Players must now kill a certain enemy X amount of times before unlocking some information on the enemy. No text has been added yet but should come in the next few updates!


Want to play with other Beta Testers? Join everyone here at 

http://steamcommunity.com/groups/starmads

See you all next time!

notes.title: Beta Patch Notes 0.3.8
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Here is the patch notes for 0.3.8 This patch is now LIVE!

This patch we are finishing up the last art pieces and getting ready for launch!

Campaign:

-Objectives have been rebalance for more of a challenge.
-The Star Map for Campaign level select has been added.
- Updated level descriptions for each level
- Levels have been LOCKED. You now must complete the levels in sequence from 1-15

Gameplay:

-Weapon: Shotgun- Now fires 5 bullets with each upgrade increasing the bullet count by 1.
-Weapon: Machine Gun- Now alternates between barrels as it shoots. Upgrades increase the RoF rather then damage.
-Damage Seal (Active): Reduce the amount of bullets it fired as well as a slight damage decrease.
-Bloodlust (Passive): Duration increased from 3 to 5
-Battle Ready(Passive): Healing increased from 5% to 20%
-Patch (Passive): Healing increased from 1% to 5%
-Patient (Passive): Healing increased from 1% to 10%
-Hard Work (Passive): now correctly increases repair time by 25%
-Mothership Boss has a major health increase
-Pirate Colony Boss now has slightly increased health as well as towers and walls
-Evil Ace (Radiation Skill): Has been greatly reduce to normal levels.
-Lightspeed now grants bullet immunity

Graphics:

-New enemy boss models
-New Skin crate look
-Updated damage particles for each class
-New Evil Ship models
-Redone all weapon upgrade models. Each Tier of weapon should have a unique looking projectile
-Added more Stilts animations

Misc:

-Fix the UI Resolution bug
-Updated tons of old/dated text in the game
-Removed Beta testing Buttons from UI
-Fix the infinite building effect on Ion Towers
-Added more stability to launching multiplayer games


Want to play with other Beta Testers? Join everyone here at 

http://steamcommunity.com/groups/starmads

See you all next time!

-Players can now start a game when an invited player is still pending.

notes.title: Beta Patch Notes 0.3.7
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Here is the patch notes for 0.3.7 This patch is now LIVE!

This patch we focus on multiplayer issues. 

Campaign:

-The Pirate Colony boss will now appear on the radar.

Gameplay:

-Cargo Seal (Active) Deals more damage per scrap piece in the ship's cargo.
-Cargo Seal (Active) Now shoots out scrap pieces rather then an asteroid.
-Sunder will only push the targets half as far.
-Having equipment that reduces the cost to towers equip will no longer instantly repair.
-Mass Repair will now fully heal all allies and towers in the game and grant a shield to players.
-Lightspeed ability now has better collision detection.

Graphics:

-Updated the graphics on the colony ship

Misc:

-Party host will now have to wait for everyone to select ready before starting a game
-The Party UI now only appears when there is actually a party.
-Reach ability will no longer spawn another mechanic ship in the background.
-Only the host now can change the survival settings.
-Players can now start a game when an invited player is still pending. 
-Players no longer need to reform the party after every game.

Want to play with other Beta Testers? Join everyone here at 

http://steamcommunity.com/groups/starmads

See you all next time!

notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Here is the patch notes for 0.3.5. This patch is now LIVE!

This patch is focus on balancing and tweaking existing campaign levels.

Campaign:

-Fix a few campaign crashes error

-Rebalance enemy waves in level 1-6 to fit more with the story line
- Fix a few instants two scrap Asteroids were spawning together

Gameplay:

- Exhaust now deals more damage from the fire
- Retaliate now deals a flat damage amount rather then scaling base on damage you took
- Retaliate has had its damage increased
- Ion tower now has a health increase per upgrade
- Ion tower projectile now travels much faster
- Flak Turret now has a health increased per upgrade
- Mines from the Mine Tower now live twice as long before self detonate.
- Laser Tower now deals more damage and greater range
- Mining laser now deals more damage
- Bomb Trap will now target better when attacking

Graphics:

-Added glow to the wall towers

-More tweaks to the main menu and gameplay lighting.

-Achievements have been added

notes.title: Beta Patch Notes 0.3.1
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Here is the patch notes for 0.3.1. This patch is now LIVE!

Gameplay:

-Weapon upgrades now also increase the projectile size per rank! (Community Request)
-Fix stun effect staying on enemies permanently.
-Fix the Repel skill so towers no longer target the shield.
-Bullets have a better collision sphere to make targeting enemies a bit easier. Upgrades weapons will also have increase collision sphere! (Community Request)
-Fix drill's endless range (Community bug report)
-Increased snipers max range. Sniper still gains its full damage by shooting the length of the screen but now will go further beyond the screen.
-Adjusted "The Big One"skill to fire less bullets with a shorter arc. (Community Request)

UI:

-Added a "F1 for controls" text to show players how to bring the control scheme back on screen.

Misc:

-Game can now handle quitting and crashing out of a multiplayer game better.
-Made a steam group for other beta testers to find each other and play! Join everyone here at 

http://steamcommunity.com/groups/starmads

See you all next time!
